blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Philippine Daily Inquirer associate publisher Juliet L. Javellana, a seasoned journalist with a career spanning over three decades, has been honored by independent global recognition platform Icons of Change for leadership in journalism. The Icons of Change International Awards 2026 align with the United Nations’ International Year of Volunteers for Sustainable Development
